prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 物流运费与时效表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "华东地区" spans 1 col × 2 row; "华南地区" spans 1 col × 2 row; "新疆、西藏全境及内蒙古阿拉善盟、青海玉树等区域，" spans 4 col × 1 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "目的地区域" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 2: header "省份" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 3: header "首重（元）" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 77px
  col 4: header "续重（元/kg）" · longest unbreakable word 68px · one-line width 99px
  col 5: header "时效" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 291px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者按目的地区域和省份查询物流首重、续重费用与预计时效，并比较不同目的地的服务。","reading":"读者先定位地区和省份，再横向读取费用与时效；也可能纵向比较各地的价格和时效。合并的地区单元格将相邻省份归为一组，偏远地区说明则横跨后四列。","groups":["目的地区域和省份共同定位目的地；地区是上一级分组，省份是具体查询项。","首重和续重都是运费，应方便并排比较，同时保留各自的计价单位。","时效与费用共同描述服务结果，但其说明性文字可能比费用数值更长。"],"keep_intact":["省份名称及首重、续重的数字。","续重表头中的元/kg单位，以及时效中的数字和时间单位。","地区名称尽量完整显示，以便快速识别行组。"],"may_wrap":["较长的时效说明可按语意自然换行。","偏远地区的跨列说明可在地名之间自然换行。","费用表头可在名称与括号单位之间换行；华东、华南的合并地区单元格已有两行数据的高度，可容纳必要的换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [76, 52, 67, 89, 75] · table 360×710px · row heights [60, 36, 176, 36, 106, 60, 106, 129] · column headers wrapped 3/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [83, 52, 67, 89, 68] · table 360×710px · row heights [60, 36, 176, 36, 129, 36, 106, 129] · column headers wrapped 3/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [68, 52, 67, 89, 83] · table 360×617px · row heights [60, 36, 129, 36, 83, 60, 83, 129] · column headers wrapped 3/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"省份和费用数字清楚，首重与续重并列，续重单位完整；跨列说明有足够宽度可阅读。","problems":"地区名称几乎都断成两行，时效说明被挤成很窄的竖条，浙江行尤其高，费用列随之出现大片空白。","cause":"地区列76px不足以容纳四字地区名；时效列75px只留54px文本宽度，长说明因此频繁换行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"83px的地区列让各地区名称完整显示，分组和行定位更容易；省份及费用数字也保持完整。","problems":"时效列最窄，浙江和广西的说明被切成许多短行，广西的“1天”还分到两行，行高与其他列的内容严重失衡。","cause":"为地区列增加宽度后，时效列缩至68px，仅有47px文本宽度；地区名称虽完整，却以说明列的可读性为代价。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"时效列加宽后，浙江、广西和四川的说明明显更易扫描，行高与空白也减少；费用列仍保留完整的数字和单位。","problems":"所有地区名都在末字前换行，单行省份对应的地区标签尤其显得局促；浙江说明仍有较多短行，表头也有三列换行。","cause":"地区列68px仅有47px文本宽度，无法容纳四字地区名；时效列83px虽较前两案改善，仍不足以让长说明舒展。"},{"design":"r2A","widths":[68,52,62,89,88],"change":"以r1C为基础，将首重列缩窄5px并全部交给时效列；首重表头仍可按名称和单位分行，争取让长时效说明更连贯。"},{"design":"r2B","widths":[83,52,62,89,73],"change":"保留完整的地区名称，将首重列缩窄5px交给时效列，检验地区识别与时效阅读之间更均衡的折中。"},{"design":"r2C","widths":[68,52,62,84,93],"change":"同时从两列费用中各借5px给时效列，探索进一步改善说明文字的效果；续重列仍有63px文本宽度，可容纳元/kg单位，但需观察括号的换行。"}]}
